summary: Alibaba Group Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Next Day Disclosure Return required under Hong Kong Exchange Listing Rules. The return discloses a share issuance of 668,000 ordinary shares at $0 per share for RSU vesting under the 2014 Post-IPO Equity Incentive Plan to a director, representing a negligible 0% increase. No price, premium, or consideration is involved as it is an equity-settled award vesting. This is a routine disclosure of equity plan administration, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review. The filing merely satisfies Hong Kong listing rule 13.25A for share movement reporting.
